title: Parse a Server-Sent Events Stream
signature: class SSEParser: last_event_id, retry, done, feed(chunk) -> list[dict]
hints: A chunk can end anywhere: in the middle of a field name, a JSON payload, or between the CR and LF of a CRLF. Keep the unfinished line in a buffer between feed() calls.
A line ends at CR, LF or CRLF. When a CR ends a line, remember it, so that an LF arriving first in the next chunk is swallowed instead of read as an empty line.
Only a blank line dispatches. Join the data lines with \n, strip one leading space from each value (not all whitespace), and keep last_event_id across events.
[DONE] is a sentinel, not a message: set done and ignore everything after it.
